description: This Java class 'InterestScheduleModelServiceGsonContext' provides methods to create instances of various loan interest schedule related data models, such as RepaymentPeriod, InterestPeriod, and ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel. It manages context information like currency, mathematical context, and loan product details for generating these instances, primarily used in loan scheduling calculations within the Fineract project.

classes.name: InterestScheduleModelServiceGsonContext
classes.description: A context class that creates instances of loan interest schedule models such as RepaymentPeriod, InterestPeriod, and ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel using provided context data like currency, math, and loan details.

methods.name: createRepaymentPeriodInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of RepaymentPeriod based on the specified type, updating the previous repayment period accordingly.

methods.name: createInterestPeriodInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of InterestPeriod based on the specified type.

methods.name: createProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModelInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel, resetting the previous reference.
